headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty rose 2% weekly as Trent and Reliance led gains amid Diwali optimism

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Buying support in Reliance Industries and sustained foreign inflows
Nifty Smallcap 100 index jumped 4%, significantly outperforming the benchmarks
Market rebound from earlier losses in anticipation of a Diwali rally
Strong performance in key sectors including FMCG and specific large-cap stocks
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty 50 indices recorded a 2% gain over the weekly wrap
India VIX increased as global crude oil prices remained elevated above $116
Trent emerged as a primary leader in the recent market rally
Adani Ports witnessed a significant surge of 4% during recent trading activity
summary: The Indian markets concluded the week on a strong note with Sensex and Nifty gaining 2% overall. Trent and Reliance Industries were major contributors to the positive momentum, while small-cap stocks outperformed the broader market. Investors are now looking forward to a potential Diwali bonanza when trading resumes on Monday.
